title: 购物英语：怎么买更划算
story: 出国旅行或在进口超市——「这个多少钱」「能便宜点吗」「有小一号吗」用英语怎么说？这一课装齐购物全流程的英语工具箱·做个体面的顾客。
aiIntro: 🛍️ 血拼的正确打开方式——购物英语

items.label: How much
items.value: How much is this? / How much are these?（单数 is·复数 are）——最通用的问价

items.label: Do you have
items.value: Do you have this in blue?（这个有蓝色的吗）——问颜色问款式一句搞定

items.label: Any discount?
items.value: Is there any discount? / Any discount for two?（买两个有折扣吗）——委婉探折扣

blocks.title: 砍价的礼貌姿势
blocks.text: Can you come down a little?（能便宜点吗）·That is a bit too expensive for me.（对我来说有点贵）——先表达喜欢再还价：漫天砍价在正规商场不适用·跳蚤市场集市才好玩：看场合出招
问价·问款·探折扣——先喜欢后还价

blocks.title: 试穿四句
items: Can I try it on?（能试穿吗）——试衣间 fitting room
Do you have a smaller / bigger size?（有小/大一码吗）——size up 大一码·size down 小一码
It is too tight / too loose.（太紧/太松）——说出问题店员才能帮你
It fits perfectly! I will take it.（很合身！我买了）——满意就果断

blocks.title: 尺码小知识
blocks.text: S / M / L / XL（small medium large extra large）——鞋码 US UK EU 各不同（看标签）：拿不准就说 Can you help me find my size?——店员最喜欢目标明确的顾客
try on 问码·说松紧·合身拿下

blocks.title: 退换三步
items: I would like to return this.（我想退这个）——return 退货·exchange 换货
It does not fit. / There is something wrong with it.（不合身/有质量问题）——说明原因
Here is the receipt.（这是小票）——小票 receipt 是退换的通行证：保留好

blocks.title: 结账用语
blocks.text: How would you like to pay?（您怎么付款）——In cash. / By card.（现金/刷卡）；Could I get a bag, please?（能给个袋子吗）：一句话文明全款拿下

blocks.title: 情景小剧场
blocks.text: 两人一组演「买 T 恤」：顾客问价→问码→试穿→砍价→付款：五步连台词不超过十句——演三轮·这辈子忘不了：口语是演会的
return/exchange + 原因 + receipt——售后三件套

sections.title: 询价砍价
sections.body:
【问价】How much is/are...?
【问款】Do you have it in blue?
【折扣】Any discount?
【还价】Can you come down a little?（集市适用）

sections.title: 试穿尺码
sections.body:
【试穿】Can I try it on?·fitting room。
【问码】a smaller/bigger size。
【反馈】too tight/loose。【成交】I will take it。

sections.title: 退换结账
sections.body:
【退】return·【换】exchange。
【原因】It does not fit.
【凭据】Here is the receipt.
【付款】In cash / By card。

steps: Do you have these in size 38?
Any bigger ones? I will take them
There is something wrong with it
I would like to exchange it

mistakes: How much are this?（单数用 is·复数才用 are）
退换时不带小票空口说（receipt 是通行证）

options: Do you have a bigger size?
Do you have a smaller size?

exercises.q: 退货时最该递给店员的是？
